what: NetEase is a Chinese online games company. It develops and runs games for PC and mobile, including long-running titles like Fantasy Westward Journey and Identity V, and it also runs a music streaming service and an online education business.
customers: Players in China above all, with a growing share of revenue from games released internationally.
money: in-game purchases from its own titles and licensed foreign games
music streaming subscriptions and social features
moat: Decades-old game franchises with loyal player bases that are expensive to replicate, and a development studio record that few Chinese rivals match.
risks: Chinese regulators control game approval licences and have frozen them before
Its most profitable games are old and eventually decline
Its partnership for licensed western titles has been unstable
Being a Chinese company listed in the US carries political and delisting risk
opportunities: It holds about $26 billion of cash against $1.9 billion of debt
International releases reduce dependence on the Chinese regulatory environment
Operating margins above 30% with a 2.5% dividend yield are unusual for a games company
watch: Revenue from new game launches against the decline of its older flagship titles.
